# indykite_service_accounts (Data Source)

List Service Accounts in the given Customer, filtered by exact name match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the service accounts of an organization with the given names.
data "indykite_service_accounts" "example" {
  customer_id = "gid:ZXhhbXBsZS1vcmdhbml6YXRpb24"
  filter      = ["my-service-account"]
}

output "service_account_ids" {
  value = [for a in data.indykite_service_accounts.example.service_accounts : a.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Identifier of Customer
- `filter` (List of String) Filter resources based on given names. Using 'exact name match' strategy to find entries.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `service_accounts` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_accounts))
